theme_plan_amendment.scope: Additive work and acceptance checks for this phase; planning only, no execution authorization

entry_gate: Previous phase completion and explicit owner authorization; recorded boundary exception may permit execution without claiming user acceptance
exit_gate: Required steps/checkpoints complete; review packet and explicit user acceptance before ordinary next-phase execution

steps.title: implement reusable activity schemas and templates
steps.work: support classification, ordering, short recall, multiple choice, evidence matching, and prediction with explanation. Store sources, answer rationale and rubric separately from attempts.
steps.source_checks: schema rejection; source anchors; correct scoring fixtures; ambiguous items marked for review; content correction invalidates dependent activities. Audit and checkpoint.

steps.title: implement hints and teach-back
steps.work: let users attempt before revealing answers, request graduated hints, and explain understanding in text; prepare the same contract for speech in Phase 10.
